limitations: Historical R3 telemetry is a pricing anchor, not a guarantee for a differently sized final mix.
Half of a paired benchmark window is an allocation assumption and must be replaced by a measured manifest estimate.
The final battery manifest must preserve separately reported Greek, maths, instruction-following, dialogue, termination and foreign-language-retention endpoints.

required_before_launch: both frozen arm manifests start from the identical pinned G2F1P0 checkpoint
same learning rate, schedule, seed, updates, batch geometry and non-maths replay
rendered and supervised token counts demonstrate matched exposure
candidate changes only the equal-token elementary-versus-competition allocation
targeted evaluation manifest includes family-disjoint maths by language/topic/difficulty, MGSM, termination, compact dialogue and multilingual retention
canonical runner test-only receipt and fresh scheduler/accounting receipt price the complete pair at no more than 4 node-hours
decision.if_pair_exceeds_four_node_hours: do not submit; reprice the end-to-end programme without silently shrinking the final battery or contingency
